title: Running Out of Room?
summary:
Main
Image reference: iStock-1298139701-resize.jpg | assets/2026-10-05_running-out-of-room_img_istock-1298139701-resize_850e2d5df027.jpg
US crude exports have grown strongly in recent years, making the US a key source of global crude supply. This raises the question of how much export capacity the US actually has. According to Kpler data, exports peaked at around 5.2 mbd in Q2, when releases from the US SPR lifted volumes by close to 1.3 mbd, or more than 30%, on the previous quarter.
